concept: Full-body concept art of a monstrous centaur warrior for a dark fantasy video game, seen strictly from the front: it faces the camera straight on, in a symmetrical standing pose. From the waist up it has the muscular torso, arms and bearded head of a savage man with long dark hair and pale scarred skin; from the waist down it has the body and four legs of a powerful dark brown horse with black hooves and a long black tail. Rig-ready pose: its two human arms hang slightly away from its torso with a clear gap between each arm and the body, its empty hands open, and it stands on its four horse legs, straight and slightly apart, every leg clearly visible and separated from the others. One single creature, centered, the whole body visible from head to feet. Plain uniform light grey studio background, no floor, no ground, no pedestal, no cast shadow, soft even studio lighting.
desc_courte: monstrous centaur, muscular bearded human torso with two arms and long dark hair on the body of a powerful dark brown horse with four legs, black hooves and a long black tail
garde: Keep the exact same creature: identical anatomy, proportions, colours and materials. Same plain uniform light grey studio background, same soft even studio lighting, same scale, the whole body visible, no floor, no cast shadow.
